@lackthereof@beige.party However, in that vein, I will say that I've decided to finally name my personal project (if it included anyone else it would be a band) to write and sing and maybe even record Extremely Serious Songs related to my professional life:

**Pigeon Guided Missile**

That's the name. We (meaning I) have Hard-Hitting, Soul-Searching songs that are Asking The Big Questions, raising the Important Issues that lesser bands won't touch. Example song titles include

  - *Dependent Means* (it's a love song)
  - *The Research Project That Would Not Die* (Strong maritime & Celtic influences)
  - *Publication Bias* (Obviously this one is funk)
  
#band #music #VerySerious #parody #psychology #research #statistics
